JavaScript

This page is a stub. It starts a minimal introduction to JavaScript. The first step is written below. The later steps are an outline. The introduction ends with two places to continue.

The first step

JavaScript is a language the browser can run. The first orientation is this: after a page is open, a short instruction can run, and the page can change. The outline of this course is drawn that way.

The rest of this mini introduction

These steps are the intended outline. They are not written out as lessons yet.

  1. A name can hold a value.
  2. A function is a small set of steps with a name.
  3. Those steps can change what the page shows.
  4. The browser console is a place to try one line.

Continue outside this course
